rationale: The response maintains a continuous football register across every sentence, inventively mapping budget concepts to plays, positions, and game-day tropes (e.g., mandatory spending as the offensive line). No plain-English clarifications appear and metaphors are pushed even when strained.
quote: The federal budget is the ultimate Super Bowl of American finance, but instead of two teams, it's 535 quarterbacks (Congress), one head coach (the President), and 330 million fans
